title: 第1928章 陈稳人麻了诸葛弃姝第1927章 一个个熟悉的人你得小心一点
slug: 被问罪当天无上帝族杀来
content_zh:
第1928章陈稳人麻了，诸葛弃姝
“嗯，小心一点为好。”
说着，洛如画的话锋一转，“她身边的那个男子看到了没有？”
陈稳点了点头。
“他叫做萧不易，是她的徒弟，这段时间里在登天盟的名声很响。”
“他还有一个身份，萧不凡的大哥。”
洛如画悠悠开口道。
“萧不凡的大哥？我杀的那个萧不凡吗。”陈稳突然开口道。
“对，就是他。”洛如画点了点头。
陈稳的目光在萧不然的身上扫了一眼，“实力确实比萧不凡强上不少，如果我没有猜错，他应该卡在凝炼四阶大帝意志的瓶颈上吧。”
洛如画点了点头，“这么跟你说吧，他这次过来应该就是为了寻找突破契机。”
“你可不要小看他了，萧梅从小就把这小子带在身边。”
“所得到的指导和资源，是你难以想象的。”
“萧不凡与之相比，只能说差太远了。”
“明白了。”
陈稳重重地点头道。
说实话，他还真的不怕什么萧不易。
也许在没有凝聚意志种子前，他确实可能会有所顾虑。
但现在不同了。
一个萧不易还能的不够他杀的。

当然了，这些话他自然不会说出来。
洛如画看了陈稳一眼，然后开口道，“不过你也不用担心。”
“哪怕你真的能把萧不易弄死，我也会保住你的。”
陈稳假装长松了一口气，“那我可就放心了。”
“你可以上去与他们交流一下，也许能结识一些志同道合的朋友也说不定。”
洛如画突然开口道。
陈稳耸了耸肩，“你也看到了，这些人有哪一个不是眼高于顶的，根本就看不起我好吧。”
洛如画并没有否认这一切，而是道，“可我看你怎么一点也不在乎的样子。”
陈稳脸上的笑容收敛，“因为我觉得没有人能让我放低身段去附和。”
“你……”洛如画整个人不由一顿。
但仅是瞬间，陈稳又半开玩笑道：“哈哈，你也被我骗到了吧。”
“其实，我这个人不善交谈，所以就不去凑这个热闹了。”
不……第一句才是他的真心话。
洛如画看着陈稳，不由深吸了一口气。
但不知为何，她并不觉得陈稳这是狂妄。
好像自当如此一样。
而就在这时，一道人影走了过来。
她怎么来了？
洛如画的眉头不由一拧。
陈稳也注意到了来人。

这是一位相貌平平的女子。
但她有着一双灰白色的眼睛，乍一看还以为她是眼瞎了。
但认真一看，并不是。
她的瞳孔是有瞧距的，是灵活的，尤其还闪动着异芒。
这让她看起来很是妖异，让人不自主地忽略了这人平平无奇的样貌。
content_en:
Chapter 1928 Chen Wen is paralyzed, Zhuge abandons Shu
"Well, it's better to be careful."
With that said, Luo Ruhua changed the subject, "Did the man next to her see it?"
Chen Wen nodded.
"His name is Xiao Buyi, and he is her apprentice. During this time, he has a very good reputation in the Dengtian League."
"He also has another identity, Xiao Bufan's eldest brother."
Luo Ruhua said leisurely.
"Xiao Bufan's eldest brother? Is it the Xiao Bufan I killed?" Chen Wen said suddenly.
"Yes, that's him." Luo Ruhua nodded.
Chen Wen glanced at Xiao Buran, "His strength is indeed much stronger than Xiao Bufan's. If I guessed correctly, he should be stuck at the bottleneck of condensing the will of the fourth-level emperor."
Luo Ruhua nodded, "Let me tell you this, he probably came here just to find a breakthrough opportunity."
"Don't underestimate him. Xiao Mei has been keeping this kid with her since she was a child."
“The guidance and resources you receive are unimaginable.”
"Compared with Xiao Bufan, I can only say that the difference is too far."
"Got it."
Chen Wen nodded heavily.
To be honest, he really wasn't afraid of Xiao Buyi.
Maybe he might indeed have some concerns before gathering the seeds of his will.
But it's different now.
Xiao Buyi is not good enough for him to kill.
Of course, he would not say these words.
Luo Ruhua glanced at Chen Wen, and then said, "But you don't have to worry."
"Even if you can really kill Xiao Buyi, I will keep you."
Chen Wen pretended to breathe a sigh of relief, "Then I'll be relieved."
"You can go up and communicate with them. Maybe you can make some like-minded friends."
Luo Ruhua suddenly spoke.
Chen Wen shrugged, "As you can see, none of these people have high standards and look down on me at all."
Luo Ruhua did not deny all this, but said, "But I see how you don't care at all."
The smile on Chen Wen's face faded, "Because I feel that no one can make me lower my stature to agree."
"You..." Luo Ruhua couldn't help but pause.
But just for a moment, Chen Wen said half-jokingly: "Haha, you must have been deceived by me too."
"Actually, I'm not good at talking, so I won't join in the fun."
No...the first sentence is his true words.
Luo Ruhua looked at Chen Wen and couldn't help but take a deep breath.
But for some reason, she didn't think Chen Wen was arrogant.
As if this is the case.
At this moment, a figure walked over.
Why is she here?
Luo Ruhua couldn't help but frown.
Chen Wen also noticed the visitor.
This is an ordinary-looking woman.
But she has a pair of gray-white eyes. At first glance, I thought she was blind.
But if you take a closer look, it's not.
Her pupils are well-spaced and flexible, and especially they sparkle with strange light.
This made her look very strange, and people couldn't help but ignore this person's ordinary appearance.
